dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 02, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Phillies Shut Down Orioles, Yastrzemski Powers Braves**

The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles 8-0 behind a strong staff effort. Bryce Harper, Alec Bohm, and Justin Crawford contributed to the offense, while Zack Wheeler shined on the mound with 3 strikeouts in 2 innings of work. In other action, Mike Yastrzemski hit a home run and drove in 2 runs to lead the Atlanta Braves past the Washington Nationals 4-2. Didier Fuentes tossed 2 scoreless innings for the Braves, striking out 4 batters.

Meanwhile, Jordan Walker had a big game for the St. Louis Cardinals, driving in 2 runs in their 5-1 win over the Toronto Blue Jays. Matthew Liberatore picked up the win, allowing just 1 run in 6 innings of work. Gavin Williams was nearly unhittable for the Cleveland Guardians, striking out 10 batters in 5.2 innings as they blanked the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-0.
